baseline.rule: per-hour site capacity sums equal per-hour arrivals

surplus.rule: per-hour site capacity sums = ceil(1.1 * per-hour arrivals)

lambda_note: optional congestion/latency weight grid for future queue experiments; no solver architecture implemented in this package
routing: complete graph by default: every origin commune may send arrivals to any candidate site; no travel limit imposed
service_model: capacity_by_hour.csv is hourly SERVICE capacity; vaccine stock/supply is a separate quantity, and unused service capacity cannot be banked into later hours
